scope: Initial first two Joey Yap source books, non-exhaustive authored paraphrases; source file SHA in parent source manifest

records.historical_claim: Year, month, day and hour each contribute one Heavenly Stem and one Earthly Branch; eight characters are a natal chart.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: requires solar calendar conversion

records.historical_claim: Ten stems identify yin or yang expression of five phases; day stem is the Day Master.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: literal stems must be reconciled with Chinese glyph

records.historical_claim: Twelve Branches represent seasonal/monthly Qi and are not interchangeable with popular animal-year stereotypes.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: animal-name trait stereotypes explicitly discounted

records.historical_claim: For Four Pillars, the solar-term calendar (not lunar New Year) governs year/month boundaries.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: author writes around February 4; exact term instants must be calculated

records.historical_claim: Month's branch changes near named solar-term dates; printed date table is a rough guide.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: consult exact Ten Thousand Year Calendar rather than rounded day

records.historical_claim: The stem of the day pillar is the reference Self Element / Day Master.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: cannot infer from calendar-year animal

records.historical_claim: Two clock hours form a traditional hour branch; hour stem depends on day stem and hour branch.
records.precondition_or_input: verified day stem and local birth clock
records.qualification_or_counterexample: explicit Early Rat and Late Rat columns

records.historical_claim: Author separates 23:00-23:59 Late Rat and 00:00-00:59 Early Rat and states day boundary at midnight.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: other Chinese schools use a 23:00 day-change variant; no silent merger

records.historical_claim: Worked example 1967-02-20 16:30 gives year Ding Wei, month Ren Yin, day Yi Mao, hour Jia Shen.
records.precondition_or_input: author's source example; no independent external parity yet
records.qualification_or_counterexample: mechanics only

records.historical_claim: Worked example 1956-03-26 09:30 gives Bing Shen, Xin Mao, Ren Chen and Yi Si from year to hour.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: page 60 prose misidentifies Day Master as Yi; chart correctly shows Ren

records.historical_claim: Worked example 1940-05-18 23:58: Geng Chen, Xin Si, Xin You, Geng Zi.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: no independent astronomical calendar implementation parity

records.historical_claim: Forward luck pillars: yang-year male or yin-year female; reverse: yin-year male or yang-year female.
records.precondition_or_input: source's historical binary gender input and natal year polarity
records.qualification_or_counterexample: not a scientific claim about gender, actual sexual orientation or future luck

records.historical_claim: Luck pillars advance/backward through sequential stem-branch pairs from natal month pillar.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: cycle does not skip

records.historical_claim: Author takes days to next/previous month solar transition, excludes birth day, divides by 3 and rounds to first Luck Pillar age.
records.precondition_or_input: direction and source solar calendar transitions
records.qualification_or_counterexample: Book 1 works in rounded integer age; do not pretend day-exact dates

records.historical_claim: Luck Pillars cover successive ten-year periods, and author also discusses annual and monthly cycles.
records.precondition_or_input: calculated first Luck Pillar and direction
records.qualification_or_counterexample: qualitative claim of luck quality not independently verified

records.historical_claim: Five phases are Wood Fire Earth Metal Water and have productive, controlling and weakening interrelationships.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: period explanatory cosmology, not verified physical energies

records.historical_claim: Month Branch/season is primary signal of Day Master strength in introductory analysis.
records.precondition_or_input: birth month branch and self element
records.qualification_or_counterexample: author explicitly says many exceptions and advanced qualifications

records.historical_claim: Chen, Wei, Xu, Chou are Earth transition months assigned Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter Earth.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: actual local climate irrelevant to branch's designated season

records.historical_claim: Source provides five relative stage labels Prosperous, Strong, Weak, Trapped, Dead for each element by season.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: ordinal qualifiers are not calibrated probabilities of events

records.historical_claim: Introductory weak Day Master favors the same element and its producing element.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: simplification subject to additional structures and exceptions

records.historical_claim: Introductory strong Day Master favors its output, the element it controls, and element that controls it.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: not valid without source-defined exceptional chart structures

records.historical_claim: Five Factors Wealth, Output, Influence, Resource, Companion are functions relative to Day Master.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: not separate celestial physical stars

records.historical_claim: Wealth maps to element controlled by Day Master; author links it to financial and gendered male spouse labels.
records.precondition_or_input: natal Day Master and generating/controlling cycle
records.qualification_or_counterexample: source sex-coded 'wife as wealth' stereotype requires separate ethical status

records.historical_claim: Output maps to element produced by Day Master and is interpreted as expressiveness or creativity.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: no known controlled behavioral validity

records.historical_claim: Influence maps to element controlling Day Master and is historically assigned rank and women’s Husband star.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: gender-coded old spouse convention not general psychological validity

records.historical_claim: Resource maps to element producing Day Master; author attributes intellect, mother, learning and intuition.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: do not infer a mother's medical status from this source

records.historical_claim: Companion maps to same phase as Day Master and is associated with peers, siblings and self-image.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: no empirical claim about a real person's psychological state

records.historical_claim: Author says exact net worth cannot be read as a bank balance; evaluates wealth capacity/period instead.
records.precondition_or_input: wealth element strength and luck period
records.qualification_or_counterexample: prevent tuning success criterion from exact wealth to vague capacity after outcome

records.historical_claim: Author explicitly notes birth-time-matched people and twins need not share outcomes, appealing to place, grave Feng Shui, face and choices.
records.precondition_or_input: same or near same natal pillar states
records.qualification_or_counterexample: additional covariates are post-hoc rescue unless measured and frozen

records.historical_claim: Every Branch can contain hidden stems; cardinal branches Zi/Wu/Mao/You have especially simple hidden stems.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: Horse Wu has two hidden stems, others one

records.historical_claim: Author warns Earthly Branch polarity and hidden Main Qi stem polarity need not match.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: do not mechanically infer hidden stem yin-yang from branch

records.historical_claim: Combination indicates links/alliances between branches, not necessarily good relationships.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: positive/negative depends on chart context

records.historical_claim: Combination families: Three Harmony (San He), Directional (San Hui), Six Harmony (Liu He).
records.qualification_or_counterexample: internal natal vs later luck-year completion distinct

records.historical_claim: Three Harmony triplets: Shen-Zi-Chen Water, Hai-Mao-Wei Wood, Yin-Wu-Xu Fire, Si-You-Chou Metal.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: do not treat one branch as complete triplet

records.historical_claim: Directional/seasonal triple combines full season Branches, e.g. spring Yin-Mao-Chen and winter Hai-Zi-Chou.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: not equivalent to the San He triples

records.historical_claim: Author differentiates an apparent combination from actual transformation to an element; season and chart factors condition transformation.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: no automatic element transformation solely from adjacency

records.historical_claim: Clashes need interpretation of favorable/unfavorable element, house/pillar, timing and five-factor involvement.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: clash does not automatically imply harm

records.historical_claim: Strict natal clash generally requires opposing Branches adjacent; nonadjacent may be latent or activated externally.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: do not automatically count nonadjacent candidates as full clash

records.historical_claim: Author allows a clash removing an unfavorable factor to be beneficial despite discomfort.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: must freeze which factor is unfavorable before testing

records.historical_claim: Four named punishment groups: Ungrateful, Bullying, Uncivilized and Self.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: classification not evidence of criminality or character

records.historical_claim: Ungrateful Yin-Si-Shen; Bullying Chou-Xu-Wei; Uncivilized Zi-Mao; self-punishment repeated Hai/You/Wu/Chen.
records.qualification_or_counterexample: formal source often additionally requires adjacency

records.historical_claim: Author requires side-by-side qualification for full natal punishment or self-punishment; external luck can supply missing participant.
records.precondition_or_input: two or three branches and positions
records.qualification_or_counterexample: record complete vs partial vs activated, never merge

records.historical_claim: Six Harm relationships derived from interruption of Six Harmony by corresponding clashes.
records.precondition_or_input: harmful branch pair and reference combination
records.qualification_or_counterexample: not identical to a clash nor independently validated

records.historical_claim: Po / Destruction is a separate branch relationship interpreted as undermining or unwanted disruption; concrete alcohol/behavior claims also appear.
records.precondition_or_input: specific source Po pair, context and period
records.qualification_or_counterexample: behavioral or addiction stereotypes not person-level findings

records.historical_claim: Case studies use interactions among branch relations, Hidden Stems, 10 Gods and Luck Pillars.
records.precondition_or_input: full previously observed personal case description
records.qualification_or_counterexample: retrospective case interpretation; never claim blind validation

records.historical_claim: Book's final chapter applies branch relations to personal historical anecdotes and notes further advanced concepts not covered.
records.precondition_or_input: case history already visible to author
records.qualification_or_counterexample: no complete executable model or tested prediction denominators

limitations: This is a preliminary coverage batch, not a completed line-by-line audit of either book.
Many modern author heuristics have undisclosed weights/exceptions; do not mark executable or predictive until exact deterministic specification and independent reference parity.
No actual person chart was read; no empirical forecasts or runtime promotion.
Modern gender-dependent spouse role is documented as historical method, not a validated trait.
